name: pilot-20
why: One or two tasks per app that the Android-only tool set can reach on a Pixel 6 / API 33 emulator with no extra apps beyond AndroidWorld's own. Mixed: 8 system settings, 2 clock, 1 composite, 9 app tasks that need typing and navigation. No task that needs the gallery import, clipboard-from-image, video or a call. Picked before any run, so the score cannot steer the pick.
